description: Combine FII/DII flow trend, market regime, breadth, and index evidence to explain market risk-on or risk-off context. Variant focus: freshness audit; timeframe: weekly review; response style: comparison matrix.
input_patterns: market regime with FII DII and breadth
is the market risk on based on flows and breadth
explain current market breadth and institutional flows

explain current market breadth and institutional flows as comparison matrix

review.rationale: Static audit and test findings drive deterministic review.

sql_templates.description: Retrieve latest combined FII/DII and market regime context.
sql_templates.template: SELECT f.trade_date, f.fii_net_5d, f.dii_net_5d, r.regime, r.confidence, r.days_in_regime FROM signals.fii_dii_flows f JOIN signals.regime_history r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date WHERE f.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM signals.fii_dii_flows);

sql_templates.description: Retrieve market breadth and index confirmation for latest date.
sql_templates.template: SELECT b.trade_date, b.advances, b.declines, b.ad_signal, i.close, i.trend_signal FROM breadth.market_daily b JOIN market.index_eod i ON b.trade_date = i.trade_date WHERE b.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM breadth.market_daily) AND i.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50';

synthesis_guidance: ['Explain FII/DII impact on regimes and signals.', 'Formulate risk stance using breadth and index data.']
title: FII DII Regime Breadth Review Variant 1996
tool_plan_template: Assess FII/DII flows, market regime, breadth, and index for risk status.
validation_rules: Ensure correct FII, DII trends and regime are present.
Verify breadth signal alignment with index trend.

steps.sql_template: SELECT * FROM signals.insider_alerts WHERE alert_date = (SELECT MAX(alert_date) FROM signals.insider_alerts) AND insider_score > 75;
steps.step: Fetch latest insider alerts with high insider scores.

steps.sql_template: SELECT * FROM signals.bulk_block_deals WHERE deal_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month';
steps.step: Fetch bulk and block deals within the last month.

steps.sql_template: SELECT * FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots);
steps.step: Get latest technical and stage context.

steps.sql_template: WITH latest_stage AS (SELECT * FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)) SELECT s.symbol, s.price, sa.stage, sb.side, sb.qty FROM signals.bulk_block_deals sb JOIN latest_stage sa ON sb.symbol = sa.symbol WHERE sb.deal_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month' AND sa.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY');

validation_rules: Ensure all fetched dates align with the latest available and respect global rules.
Check that joins only use approved schema join rules.

description: Analyze previous trading signals, their outcomes, and learnings for optimization.
input_patterns: review prior signals
evaluate signal outcomes
weekly outcome review

review.rationale: Static audit and test findings drive deterministic review.

sql_templates.description: Fetch resolved signals and their outcomes.
sql_templates.template: SELECT symbol, date_issued, signal, hit_target, hit_stop, return_pct FROM signals.signal_log WHERE date_resolved IS NOT NULL;

sql_templates.description: Join latest market prices with signal logs.
sql_templates.template: WITH latest_prices AS (SELECT symbol, MAX(trade_date) AS trade_date FROM market.equity_eod GROUP BY symbol) SELECT s.symbol, s.date_issued, e.close AS latest_close FROM signals.signal_log s JOIN latest_prices lp ON s.symbol = lp.symbol JOIN market.equity_eod e ON lp.symbol = e.symbol AND lp.trade_date = e.trade_date WHERE s.date_resolved IS NOT NULL;

synthesis_guidance: Evaluate patterns to identify which signals were successful.
title: Signal Outcome Analysis
tool_plan_template: Gather signal logs and correlate with market data to determine effectiveness.
validation_rules: Ensure all fields from evidence_request are populated.
